page.overview:
Who is Flaxan Leader?

The Flaxan Leader was a prominent figure among the alien Flaxan race, initially appearing as just another soldier during their first invasion of Earth. However, after surviving that failed assault and receiving a disfiguring scar from Invincible, he rose through the ranks to become the leader of the second and third Flaxan invasions.

Fueled by vengeance and a desire to conquer Earth, he quickly became one of Invincible’s most persistent and personal adversaries. His reign of terror came to a violent end when Omni-Man followed the Flaxans through their portal into their home dimension and singlehandedly annihilated their civilization, brutally killing the Flaxan Leader in the process.

The Flaxan Leader was a green-skinned alien distinguished by six antennae and striking black eyes with yellow, vertical pupils.

During the first invasion, he appeared as a standard soldier, clad in a blue jumpsuit complemented by white armor. This armor included a chest plate, pelvic guard, shoulder and knee pads, and sturdy boots, functional and uniform in design.
